context.p: Use the Validate action to ensure that all smart fields in your document are in the proper format for their assigned data type (e.g., Date, Number, DateTime, selected values from picklists,etc.). The agreement document cannot be reconciled at check-in unless all fields in your document are valid.

stepresult.p: If any fields are invalid, the field row in the Document pane will be highlighted in red.

step.cmd: Make any corrections to invalid fields as needed and click Validate again to confirm there are no invalid fields.

result.p: If all fields are valid, a success message is displayed at the bottom of the pane. You can now check in your document.
